import math

# Data from December 1941 to December 1942 (in millions of dollars)
# Bonds (interest-bearing public debt outstanding)
bonds = [40000, 42078, 44305, 44847, 45363, 48157, 48776, 51765, 53680, 54413, 57285, 57931, 64868]

# Bills and certificates of indebtedness (CIs)
bills_ci = [2002, 2101, 2002, 1652, 3460, 3764, 5604, 6759, 8873, 10829, 11336, 12882, 17161]

print(f"Number of data points: {len(bonds)}")
print(f"\nBonds: {bonds}")
print(f"Bills and CIs: {bills_ci}")

# Calculate Pearson correlation coefficient
n = len(bonds)
mean_x = sum(bonds) / n
mean_y = sum(bills_ci) / n

# Calculate numerator and denominators
numerator = sum((bonds[i] - mean_x) * (bills_ci[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n))
sum_sq_x = sum((bonds[i] - mean_x) ** 2 for i in range(n))
sum_sq_y = sum((bills_ci[i] - mean_y) ** 2 for i in range(n))

denominator = math.sqrt(sum_sq_x * sum_sq_y)

r = numerator / denominator

print(f"\nMean Bonds: {mean_x:.2f}")
print(f"Mean Bills/CIs: {mean_y:.2f}")
print(f"\nPearson correlation coefficient: {r}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(r, 3)}")
EOF
